text: …　…　だきしめて…　ねるときも…　…　じゃろ…　…　…　…　すばらし…！

patterns.name: 〜とき
patterns.explanation: とき after a plain verb means 'when doing that', and も adds 'even'. ねるときも = 'even when I sleep'.

patterns.name: 〜だろう
patterns.explanation: じゃろ is the old-man form of だろう, used to ask the listener to agree. じゃろ = 'isn't it?'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next one, like 'and'. だきしめて = 'I hug it tight and...'.
